titulo: The envelope on the floor by the door
caption:
The envelope on the floor by the door

"I'll remember it." "Right in your way." The envelope landed on the floor by the door, and it was not getting left behind.

What you must carry out belongs where you will trip over it, not where you will remember it.

For whoever leaves what has to go out right in front of the door.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a closed cream door on the right and a cream envelope floating next to it. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes at the left says I'll remember it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers right in your way, and the envelope hops in an arc and lands on the floor right beside the door. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...ok. can't miss it. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me leaving it in the way.
